_comment: Categories of vocabulary terms (output/vocabulary.json) that are force-included in every consilium's keywords_final whenever present in that consilium's pre-reduction keywords.argument/keywords.body, regardless of what the two-pass GPU reduction (src/gpu/reduce_keywords.py) happened to select. Curated by legal-historical/analytical judgment, not frequency. Applied by src/enforce_protected_keywords.py, which runs after apply_keyword_reduction.py. A consilium touching a protected category may end up with more than the nominal ~10 keywords_final — that's intended: guaranteed discoverability of a defined research area takes priority over the target count.

intimate_and_reproductive_body._description: User-defined research category ('the intimate and reproductive body', 2026-08-07): sexual acts and offenses, marriage considered as bodily/sexual union (not its economic/contractual side), reproduction/pregnancy/birth and its legal-medical vocabulary, and legitimacy-of-birth consequences. Deliberately excludes marriage's property side (dowry, marriage settlements, marital property/gifts), paternal *authority* terms (paternal power/inheritance/fief — about legal authority, not the body), and marriage-sequence bookkeeping (first/second/subsequent marriage, remarriage) which are about family structure and succession timing rather than the body itself. Also excludes two false-positive homonyms caught during curation: 'consummation of crime' (completion of a criminal act, unrelated sense of 'consummation') and 'maritime law' (unrelated to 'marital').
